description:
Mirfak Parcel Service - English Translation
Safe. Swift. Superior. Your first choice for logistics.

>> Download v0.7.4-EN <<

A full translation of.... mail-company?? ;D

About
Mirfak Parcel Service is a logistics company on the Hegemony's fringe. Everyone calls it neutral, non-military and friendly. They deliver anything, anywhere in the Core Worlds, from bulk commodities to a handful of personal letters.

But if you think Mirfak is just an ordinary courier, their armed freighters will be happy to give you and your ships a lift... as salvage.

Built on top of Domain ruins in the Mirfak system, Mirfak has quietly grown into something the Hegemony can't ignore - and can't quite control.

Features

A new faction and star system - Mirfak, with the terraformed world Azure Peak, the mining world Serried Peaks, Domain ruins, a gate and a Hegemony oversight station
~20 ships - armed freighters, carrier nodes, battlecruisers, flagships and the Armistice industrial mothership
Custom fighters and LPCs - including the Soaring Dragon, Jade Cage, Nine Cauldrons and SA-47 Peregrine
Unique weapons - the RX Overlimit series, Icefall, Ink Abyss, container VLS launchers and the Pear Blossom Storm, Billowing Clouds and Miasma missile families
Mirfak hullmods - combat and logistics specializations on the Embedded Smart Core. Build them in to unlock powerful Deep Subsystems
Store system - buy corporate bonds, shop the VIP store, collect monthly dividends, and visit Miss Luo's Mystery Shop for rare ships

Ships

Spearpoint - special destroyer, extreme mobility and burst
Edgebreaker - phase-maneuvering destroyer built on Spearpoint tech
Gulfstream / Benchmark - armed standard freighters
Celestial Pivot / Eternal Canopy / Celestial Pillar - carrier nodes
Wangke - special prototype cruiser that grows stronger with every kill
Guest Star - battlecruiser with the Starstring main gun
Polaris - carrier hub with Black Armor drone defense platforms
Silk Road / Star Satin - flagship and prototype
Armistice - industrial mothership with swappable drone swarms

Deep Subsystems
Build these Mirfak hullmods into a ship to unlock their Deep Subsystems:
"Folding Mirror" - Electromagnetic Phase-Change Armor
"Terraces" - Overlimit Overdrive
"Prosthesis" - Emergency Maneuvers (lateral dash + afterburner)
"Biphasic" - Dissipation Arcs
"Spirit Eye" - Vector Correction
"Ternary" - Keen Eye
"Goban" - Elite Outfitting
"Afterimage" - Potential Accelerator

Requirements

Starsector 0.98
LazyLib
MagicLib
GraphicLib
BoxUtil

Installation
Unzip into your Starsector/mods folder so the path reads mods/Mirfak Parcel Service/mod_info.json, then enable it in the launcher.
If you use TriOS and also have the Chinese version installed, select 0.7.4-EN as the active version.

Translation Permission

My request: "Hello! I'd like to ask for your permission to translate your mod into English and share it with the English Starsector community."

The author's reply: "I have no objection - in a way, it's an honor. But translating it will be tough, since almost all of my text is hardcoded. It'll be painful for you. Also, it'd be best if you joined the group so we can communicate more easily."

AI Use Disclaimer
AI assistance for translation and a bit of polishing.

About This Translation
Everything is in English - ships, weapons, hullmods, ship systems, descriptions, dialogue, the full changelog and the lore documents.
Found a typo or awkward wording? Post it in this thread!

Credits

Original mod: Lee Thousand (code, art, writing, design)
Writing assistance: Huawu Xumeng
English translation: MrPossible, with the author's permission

Changelog
See changelog.txt in the mod folder for the full history from v0.56 to v0.7.4.

changelog.0.7.4b-EN:
Fixed missing Longbow and Crossbow sprites on Linux (file name capitalization mismatches).
 Fixed the Fowling Piece projectile sprite pointing to the wrong folder (missing on all systems).
changelog.0.7.4-EN:
Added Version Checker support. You'll now get an in-game notice when a new English version is out.
 Fixed the Needle Case weapon missing its sprites. A hidden character in its image file names had been garbled, so the game couldn't find them.
 Renamed 29 garbled file and folder names (author's art sources, design notes and reference files) to plain English. None of these are loaded by the game, but the garbled names could cause problems when unzipping on Windows.
